verdict.rationale: The privacy policy confirms an official Mac OS app, and the homepage says Instinct connects to your 'screen', so a desktop app with screen access is claimed. However, both are single passing mentions, and the vendor stresses 'no new interfaces' (you text or call it). Missing for 10: any evidence of OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, documentation of how the desktop app reads screen content, Windows/Linux availability, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the desktop app.
